critique.evidence: The dark grid, cyan/teal/red palette, bold two-tone thesis headline, consistent outlined cards, and restrained technical typography create a distinctive, polished visual system. Desktop hierarchy is strong and the diagram supports the narrative. However, responsive composition is not fully demo-ready: tablet navigation is visibly clipped, while mobile removes the header and turns the diagram into a very tall, loosely connected sequence with excessive dead space. The final “AUTHENTIC ≠ INTENDED” callout is detached far below the payment card on mobile, and several card labels wrap awkwardly into tiny uppercase fragments. Desktop also feels slightly right-heavy, with substantial unused lower space.
critique.fix: Refine responsive layouts rather than merely stacking: provide a deliberate compact mobile/tablet header, keep the outcome callout attached to the payment card, shorten connector paths and vertical gaps, and adjust card widths/type sizes to prevent awkward label wrapping. Rebalance the desktop hero and diagram vertically to reduce dead space and ensure the full navigation fits without clipping.
